say: A thousand agents start in ramps, about three hundred and fifty busy at once. Each writes one line in a shared index, so they collide thousands of times, and every collision is redone on the newest code.

The run's own page: the index check, five thousand seven hundred eighty-seven lines, none missing; every one of the two thousand seven hundred ninety-one collisions redone; and the files the checks rejected were left unchanged.
